reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Changes to RBAC with Dex SSO Authentication: When using Dex, the `sub` claim returned in the authentication was used as the subject for RBAC", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: permission-lost

consequence.statement: RBAC policies that use the Dex sub claim as the subject no longer match the user, so those users lose the access the policies granted.
consequence.remediation: Update the RBAC policies to use the user_id value (decode the current sub claims to find it), and use the new CLI version to obtain tokens with the appropriate claims.

proposed.statement: With Dex SSO, Argo CD 3.0 bases the RBAC subject on the federated_claims.user_id claim (requesting the federated:id scope) instead of the sub claim, so RBAC policies that reference the Dex sub claim must be updated to keep the same access.
